title: Chronologically Accurate Retrieval for Temporal Grounding of Motion-Language Models

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Despite these efforts to align language and motion representations, we claim that the temporal element is often overlooked, especially for compound actions, resulting in chronological inaccuracies.

problems.evidence_sentence: Chronologically Accurate Retrieval for Temporal Grounding of Motion-Language Models With the release of large-scale motion datasets with textual annotations, the task of establishing a robust latent space for language and 3D human motion has recently witnessed a surge of interest.
